comment.body: Thanks for the two Windows editions and confirming that text transfer works while files do not. The report does not identify direction or what happens on the receiving side. Could you try the same small, non-sensitive .txt file from Windows 11 to Windows 10 and then from Windows 10 to Windows 11, and report its approximate size plus whether each receiver shows progress, an error, or nothing? Please do not upload a private file. This will show whether the failure is direction-specific or affects the file-transfer path generally.
